jugxoj.kialo: Ekzemplo speaks playfully: a start button may say Los geht's! instead of naming the verb, because the brand's voice carries the invitation and the surrounding screen says what starts. The rule is adjustable; the fixed rules for destructive labels stay untouched.
jugxoj.context: Override of the adjustable text rule label-names-action by the test Aspekto ekzemplo (Spec 007 T024, S4, data-model §7).
